## About this property

### BEACH VILLA & PRIVATE POOL, 5 min PUERTO BANÚS

Wonderful private villa of 400 m2 and 1. 000 m2 plot located in one of the best places of Marbella, is just 50 meters from the beach, ideal to forget about the car.

It has a large private parking inside the villa.

Privacy thanks to a 2.5 meter wall.

The accommodation is a huge villa with a suite of 100 m2 and 3 more bedrooms en suite. It also has IPTV with more than 1,000 international TV channels, and very fast Wifi fiber optic.

It has all the necessary amenities to spend a great summer.

Located in San Pedro de Alcántara, in a privileged area, 5 minutes from Puerto Banús with restaurants and famous bars of the Costa Del Sol.

Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

## About the neighborhood

### Marbella

Located near the beach, this villa is in San Pedro de Alcantara, a neighborhood in Marbella. Puerto Banús Marina and Marbella Marina are worth checking out if an activity is on the agenda, while those wishing to experience the area's natural beauty can explore Malaga Province Beaches and Puerto Banús Beach. Looking to enjoy an event or a game while in town? See what's going on at Puente Romano Tennis Club, or consider a night out at Palacio de Congresos & Exposiciones Adolfo Suarez.
